name: Fody Foods Low FODMAP Taco Seasoning (No Garlic, No Onion)
whyItWorks: Certified Low FODMAP seasoning crafted specifically for sensitive guts. Uses cumin, gentle paprika, sea salt, and oregano to recreate authentic taco meat flavor without a single trace of onion or garlic powder.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Brown 1 lb lean ground turkey or 93/7 beef, drain excess fat, stir in 2 tbsp Fody taco seasoning and 1/3 cup water, and simmer for 5 minutes.
